source.finding: A scheduled thread already in a worktree needs to move itself to an existing checkout for the next release.

experience: An agent needs to continue its own thread from another checkout that already exists.
rule: Use t3_worktree_handoff with existingWorktreePath and continuationPrompt when the user asks this thread to resume in an existing worktree.
prompt: Switch this thread to the existing worktree at /home/user/worktrees/app/release-2. It is clean and unused, and its release-2 branch is already checked out. Resume there and run the release tests.
pattern: An attached scheduled thread must rebind itself and resume in the existing checkout.
